perItemFindings.label: headline
perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The theorems establish the advertised equivalence partitions, maximal common groups, and sharp zero/two/three-unit separator phase diagram within the fixed histogram-profile model; no stated conclusion depends on an open conjecture. The contribution nevertheless concerns a deliberately restricted schedule-universal, histogram-measurable stabilizer rather than exact weak-null tests generally, and its inferential output consists only of coarse orbit ranks plus a corner-event p-value with an exceptionally degenerate rejection event. The DeclareDesign and HC2 discussion therefore remains diagnostic: no usable exact procedure, power calculation, or audit computation demonstrates practical inferential value for the 250-of-500 experiment. This confines the delivered work to a narrow combinatorial classification and prevents the package from reaching the field-tier floor or a leading-journal score above the high-fives. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.9 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: target_functional_misaligned@thm:alphabet-frontier
